_meta.what: Post-patch verification of the electric path THROUGH THE MCP TOOL after applying the source.cal A1 fix (sudo apply_source_cal_patch.sh).

glare_ugr_postpatch.note: The pre-patch UGR=0 was NOT a separate bug -- it was the same A1 under-emission (fixtures 14x too dim -> below evalglare's glare threshold -> UGR clamped to 0). Post-patch UGR=19.24 (= the standard office glare limit) and DGP=0.199 (<0.35 imperceptible) are realistic and consistent.

verdict: Electric path fully validated on this machine end-to-end via the MCP tool: ~14x illuminance correction confirmed (412-623 lux), and glare (UGR 19.24 / DGP 0.199) now sane. Closes BOTH the electric magnitude item AND the UGR=0 anomaly (same root cause).
